Alright... A new month begins, and with it... the release of a new public story! But wait... a simple story? What happened to the main story? Don't worry, the main story will arrive in the third week of the month. This public story was released to commemorate my 4th anniversary of creating stories... Why? Because it's a vampire story, just like my first story made in koikatsu. The story is the sequel to the minicomic "Vampire Goddess: Reborn." We'll see how the new queen slowly begins to infect the city and her former heroine companions. Without further ado, I hope you enjoy it!
